description.en: Opens the blinds in the morning with the sun, but not before a set time, and closes them in the evening when the sun goes down.
description.de: Öffnet die Rollläden morgens mit der Sonne, aber nicht vor einer eingestellten Uhrzeit, und schließt sie abends, wenn die Sonne untergeht.

author: GermanBluefox

description.en: In ioBroker 100 % is open. If your blinds count the other way, swap the two positions.
description.de: In ioBroker ist 100 % offen. Zählen die Rollläden andersherum, die beiden Positionen tauschen.

blockly:
<xml xmlns="https://developers.google.com/blockly/xml">
  <block type="astro" x="10" y="10">
    <field name="TYPE">{{openEvent}}</field>
    <field name="OFFSET">0</field>
    <statement name="STATEMENT">
      <block type="controls_if">
        <value name="IF0">
          <block type="time_compare">
            <mutation end_time="false"></mutation>
            <field name="OPTION">>=</field>
            <field name="START_TIME">{{earliest}}</field>
          </block>
        </value>
        <statement name="DO0">
{{#each blinds}}
          <block type="control">
            <mutation delay_input="false"></mutation>
            <field name="OID">{{blinds.SET}}</field>
            <field name="WITH_DELAY">FALSE</field>
            <value name="VALUE">
              <block type="math_number">
                <field name="NUM">{{openLevel}}</field>
              </block>
            </value>
          </block>
{{/each}}
        </statement>
      </block>
    </statement>
    <next>
      <block type="schedule">
        <field name="SCHEDULE">{{earliest.minute}} {{earliest.hour}} * * *</field>
        <statement name="STATEMENT">
          <block type="controls_if">
            <value name="IF0">
              <block type="time_compare">
                <mutation end_time="true"></mutation>
                <field name="OPTION">between</field>
                <field name="START_TIME">{{openEvent}}</field>
                <field name="END_TIME">{{closeEvent}}</field>
              </block>
            </value>
            <statement name="DO0">
{{#each blinds}}
              <block type="control">
                <mutation delay_input="false"></mutation>
                <field name="OID">{{blinds.SET}}</field>
                <field name="WITH_DELAY">FALSE</field>
                <value name="VALUE">
                  <block type="math_number">
                    <field name="NUM">{{openLevel}}</field>
                  </block>
                </value>
              </block>
{{/each}}
            </statement>
          </block>
        </statement>
        <next>
          <block type="astro">
            <field name="TYPE">{{closeEvent}}</field>
            <field name="OFFSET">0</field>
            <statement name="STATEMENT">
{{#each blinds}}
              <block type="control">
                <mutation delay_input="false"></mutation>
                <field name="OID">{{blinds.SET}}</field>
                <field name="WITH_DELAY">FALSE</field>
                <value name="VALUE">
                  <block type="math_number">
                    <field name="NUM">{{closeLevel}}</field>
                  </block>
                </value>
              </block>
{{/each}}
            </statement>
          </block>
        </next>
      </block>
    </next>
  </block>
</xml>
